name: Race Dash
author: Sedz
description: A steering wheel LCD laid out like a real F1 dash: last lap, RPM, live delta, speed, lap, SOC with a 20-segment bar, tyre temperatures and wear, gear, position, fuel, gaps, fuel mix, ERS mode and brake bias, with pop-ups for setting changes, safety cars and red flags. Reads the game's own UDP telemetry packets in the game (passed through unchanged, no sockets opened).

options.label: Debug log
options.description: Write the dash's lap timing and values to swofty/loader.log every 10 seconds.
